data.action: 趴在窗边木桌上托腮打盹
data.description: 【羽毛笔 · 雨窗微困】雨水连绵的午后，拉菲艾拉双手托腮趴在休息室的圆木桌上，小脑袋一点一点地打着瞌睡，长长的睫毛在白皙的面颊上投下柔和的阴影。察觉到你在她身上搭了件薄毯，她软糯地哼唧了一声——「唔……好暖和……谢谢博士……」
data.lighting: soft diffused overcast light, reflective rainy window, warm indoor lamp glow
data.promptProse: La Pluma nods off at a round wooden table beside the rainy lounge window, both palms cradling her cheeks. A thin blanket covers her oversized pink hoodie. In medium close-up, the near tabletop curves around her elbows and rain trails obscure the room's exterior. Overcast light softens her lashes' shadows; the indoor lamp warms the blanket edge and wood beneath her hands.
data.title: 羽毛笔 · 雨窗微困
